label: Dominance
subgoals: Compare two candidates in load and required time
Discard any candidate beaten in both
Check that the survivors' required times rise with load

label: Choosing at the driver
subgoals: Compute q minus driver resistance times load for each candidate
Trace back the stored decisions to recover the buffers

label: Pruning after a buffer site
subgoals: Note that every buffered candidate has the same load
Keep only the buffered candidate with the largest required time
Bound the list growth to one entry per site per buffer type
